description: We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a compassionate and skilled nursing professional ready to make a significant impact on our community.The ideal candidate will be an RN with a strong background in long-term care, eager to take on a leadership challenge. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your experience and commitment to excellence. Join a team where your expertise is valued, and your contributions directly enhance the well-being of our residents.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Prior experience in a supervisory or leadership nursing role
Strong understanding of clinical best practices and regulatory compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
